profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Productivity @ Sonos | Automation, Diagnostics, AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.summary:
I've spent most of my career working on difficult connectivity, automation, and systems problems.
My background started in wireless interoperability and protocol conformance, where I worked extensively with 802.11 networking, automation, and large-scale test infrastructure. Over time my interests expanded into engineering productivity, observability, diagnostics, and more recently AI-assisted engineering workflows.

Today I work in engineering productivity at Sonos, where much of my time is spent helping engineers understand complex failures, improving automation infrastructure, and building tools that reduce the effort required to debug and validate software changes. Lately that has included a lot of experimentation with Claude Code, MCP integrations, and ways to make AI more effective for real engineering work.

I enjoy digging into systems that span hardware, software, networking, and infrastructure, especially when the problem isn't obvious and requires a mix of data, intuition, and experimentation to solve.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Productivity
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer on the Engineering Productivity team supporting embedded networking systems development and validation infrastructure.

Build tools and workflows that improve engineering efficiency, accelerate root-cause analysis, and increase visibility into software quality. Areas of focus include automation, diagnostics, observability, release readiness, and AI-assisted engineering.

positions.title: Senior Wi-Fi Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Focused on building the automation, infrastructure, and tooling behind Apple's wireless qualification ecosystem.

Contributed to systems responsible for deployment, orchestration, diagnostics, and large-scale data analysis, while helping investigate and resolve complex issues spanning hardware, software, networking, and wireless protocols.

positions.title: Wi-Fi Interoperability Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Built and led Apple's Wi-Fi Interoperability Engineering team, establishing processes, infrastructure, and automation used to evaluate Wi-Fi performance and interoperability across Apple products.
Worked closely with cross-functional teams to improve quality, scale testing efforts, and drive resolution of complex networking issues.

positions.title: Lead Wi-Fi Interoperability Engineer
positions.description:
Founded Apple's Wi-Fi interoperability program, building the infrastructure, automation, and test methodologies used to evaluate wireless compatibility and performance across Apple products.

Solving complex networking problems, improving interoperability, and scaling qualification efforts through automation and data-driven analysis.

positions.title: Technical Manager, R&D - Wireless Consortium
positions.description: Led interoperability and certification efforts for wireless networking vendors while overseeing automation, test infrastructure, and standards-based validation programs.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test - Wireless Consortium
positions.description: Developed Wi-Fi and Z-Wave automation frameworks, validation systems, and technical analysis used to support interoperability, protocol conformance, and WFA pre-cert testing.

projects.title: City of Portsmouth, NH Free Public Wi-Fi
projects.description: Site Surveys, Deployment, and Tuning for the Wi-Fi deployment in Portsmouth, NH

publications.title: A Comparison of Efficiency, Throughput, and Energy Requirements of Wireless Access Points

patents.title: Methods and apparatus for network signaling during low-power operation
